title: book-maker spine
description: The book's through-line: thesis, arc, and accumulation architecture. Built after research is verified, before architecture. The accumulation fields (global_value_shift, leitmotifs, narrator_arc, weight_trajectory, recapitulation_targets) transform the book from a collection of chapters into a progressive experience where each chapter carries the emotional residue of everything before it.

thesis.description: One-sentence thesis statement for the entire book.

thesis_expanded.description: One-paragraph expansion: setup, three complications, resolution.

reader_enters.description: What the reader believes and feels about the subject before reading. Not just knowledge state — emotional stance.

reader_exits.description: What the reader believes and feels after the final page. The emotional distance from entry to exit is the book's weight.

global_value_shift.description: The book-level emotional transformation. Each chapter's value shift is a progressive complication of this global shift.

leitmotifs.description: Concrete images, phrases, or scenes that recur across 3+ chapters with transforming meaning. A leitmotif is not a concept (those are threads). It is a specific sensory detail whose emotional weight changes as the reader accumulates experience.

stance_early.description: The narrator's relationship to the material in the first third: curious, investigating, observing.

stance_mid.description: The narrator's relationship in the middle: troubled, committed, surprised, challenged.

stance_late.description: The narrator's relationship in the final third: resolved, transformed, urgently committed, humbled.

narrator_arc.description: How the narrator changes across the book. The narrator at chapter 10 is not the same narrator as chapter 1. The voice itself carries the accumulation.

weight_trajectory.description: The emotional weight the reader carries at each chapter boundary. Stakes must escalate — no chapter's weight is lower than the previous.

recapitulation_targets.description: Specific details from early chapters that the final chapter revisits in transformed context. The reader recognises the detail but experiences it differently because of everything that happened between.

movement.description: What the reader learns or experiences during this beat.

image.description: The concrete sensory detail: a phrase, an image, a scene fragment. Not an abstract concept.

meaning.description: What the image means at this point in the book — must differ from every other appearance.

weight.description: What the reader FEELS about what they know at this point. Not what they know — what it weighs.
